title: GeoCool-In
summary: A monitoring platform for geothermal climate systems on farms. Sensors on site collect the data and the web shows what is going on. Still in progress.
role: I lead the technical side: a monorepo with the corporate website, a sensor data ingestion API and a client portal, built with Next.js and Payload CMS.

title: Shyla Jewellery
summary: Online shop for a jewellery brand, built headless: Shopify runs the commerce, Sanity the content and Next.js the storefront.
role: Part of a small team. I worked on the storefront and the shop features, brought in Shopify data through its GraphQL API and built interactions and animations with GSAP.

title: Madri+D
summary: Two projects for Madri+d, Madrid's research and innovation network. Startup Radar brings startups, mentors, incubators and institutions together, with more than 6,000 users. Mochila Digital Universitaria is a course catalogue with a private intranet.
role: On Startup Radar, with Django and as part of a team, I kept existing code growing: user roles, complex forms, search and admin workflows. Mochila Digital Universitaria, in WordPress, was about 95% mine: a custom theme, a private area and an advanced AJAX search.

title: VIT
summary: Website and back office for Viatges Independents i Trekkings, a travel agency.
role: Built end to end on my own with Django: a custom trip search, tools for the agency staff and a back office that turns database content into styled PDF travel documents and Excel files. I also handled the deployment.

title: Prewaste
summary: Services catalogue for a sustainability consulting firm, told as a story that unfolds as you scroll.
role: Built on my own as a custom WordPress theme. Most of the work went into the animated, scroll-driven layouts: GSAP, ScrollMagic, Lottie and custom SVG.

title: Live Unfinished
summary: Website for Unfinished Live 2022, a hybrid event about technology, innovation and art held in New York.
role: I built about 85% of it, front and back, with Django, and deployed it with nginx. A complex layout full of movement: JavaScript animations, interactive SVGs and advanced CSS. Light integration with Bizzabo, through its API and iframes restyled to feel like part of the site.

title: Barabási Lab
summary: Portfolio site for an artist and scientist, with a large body of work you explore through search.
role: I built about 90% of it, front and back, with Django. An advanced live search (Django and AJAX) across every type of content, and fluid, animated geometric layouts that adapt to any screen.

heading: Hi, I'm Elsa.
bio:
Full-stack software engineer based in Barcelona. I build web applications end to end, with a focus on complex front ends.

I have an industrial engineering background with experience in scientific computing. I love coding, modelling and planning.

I also make music and I'm passionate about cinema, culture, people and cooking.

title: Dinàmica
summary: Website for Dinàmica Arquitectura, an architecture studio.
role: Built on my own, front and back, with Django and Webpack. GSAP animations follow the scroll.

title: No és culpa meva
summary: Website for a public mental health campaign, where people could read, watch and share their own stories. The site is no longer online.
role: Full stack, about 80% of the build. Django and PostgreSQL behind; in front, horizontal layouts, window-like interactions and animations with GSAP, AOS and Swiper.

title: QFactory
summary: Catalogue website for QFactory, a small leather goods firm, told through scroll.
role: Built on my own, front and back, with Django. A storytelling single-pager with complex layered motion layouts, driven by the scroll with GSAP, ScrollTrigger and Smooth Scrollbar.
